title: Issue and PR body shape: requested by an Issue Form and PR template, enforced by check_pr_traceability on the PR body
objective: Give Issue and PR bodies a shape that is REQUESTED on GitHub (an Issue Form and a PR template) and ENFORCED where BADF reads it: check_pr_traceability.py verifies the PR template's required section headings in addition to the two trailer lines. Demand bodies are NOT enforced in load_demand -- an issue-kind demand's problem is a verbatim, digest-bound export of the source Issue and must not be rewritten (e.g. BADF-DEM-0016 is the external #41 with a different structure); the Issue Form is the requested shape for new Issues.
business_value: gh --body-file bypasses web templates, so templates alone enforce nothing; every artifact this session was filed that way. The shape becomes a control only where the gate/CI reads it.
in_scope: check_pr_traceability.py: required section headings (What / Verification) plus the two trailer lines
the template headings and the check agree (a self-consistency test)
doctrine note; tests failing-first; mutation; compose
out_of_scope: enforcing demand-body shape in load_demand (would rewrite or reject digest-bound external exports)
a network check that an Issue exists
acceptance_criteria: a PR body missing a required section fails check_pr_traceability naming it, and one with the sections + trailers passes
the Issue Form and PR template exist; the template's headings equal the check's required set (test)
the current WP-0034 PR body satisfies the check
load_demand and every shipped demand are unchanged (no demand-body enforcement)
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch. Carries its own G07 self-dossier.
